name: context-threshold-notify
description: A clickable macOS notification when a Claude Code session's context passes a token threshold. Clicking it brings that session's terminal tab to the front.

window_tokens.title: Context window (tokens)
window_tokens.description: Your model's context window, e.g. 200000 or 1000000. Empty guesses it: a model name with [1m] means 1000000, anything else 200000 (see README).

percent.title: Notify at percent of window
percent.description: Whole number from 1 to 100, no leading zero.

threshold_tokens.title: Absolute threshold (tokens)
threshold_tokens.description: Overrides window and percent when set, e.g. 500000.
